roadmap.title: GoatVille
roadmap.description: Clear the base map's stunts, quests, and 30 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Goat City Bay
roadmap.description: Finish the coastal map's batteries, hats, and 30 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Buck to School
roadmap.description: Play the mobile school map's pranks and 10 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Goat MMO Simulator
roadmap.description: Work through the MMO classes, zone travel, and 20 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: GoatZ
roadmap.description: Survive the zombie map, run the Whiplash course, and collect 32 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: PAYDAY
roadmap.description: Run the heist map's car stunts, ring race, and 20 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Waste of Space
roadmap.description: Finish the colony's swords, test chambers, Badehaus, and 30 goat trophies.

achievements.description: Visit 5 trampolines in one jump bouncing on each trampoline once
achievements.summary: Bounce on five trampolines in a single jump without touching the ground.

guide.context: The Angel Goat mutator makes the glide easier, and holding R stabilizes each landing.

steps.text: Launch into the air from the construction-site fan.
Bounce once on each of the five trampolines across GoatVille without touching the ground between them.

achievements.description: Sacrifice 3 Sanctum items
achievements.summary: Sacrifice the two Sanctum figures and the G-2 robot on the GoatVille pentagram.

guide.context: The pentagram is uphill from the red house, beyond the backyard party. The Angel Goat mutator, earned by doing nothing for five minutes, lets you glide across the map to gather the items.

steps.text: Go upstairs in the house beside the fenced area and lick the Sanctum 1 figure in its bedroom.
Bounce on the trampoline by the starting farm to reach the treehouse and lick the Sanctum 2 figure.
Reach the blue container dangling from the construction crane with the rooftop fans or a trampoline, headbutt the G-2 robot, then lick it.
Place all three items in the middle of the pentagram uphill from the red house.

achievements.description: Do 10 front flips in one trick
achievements.summary: Perform 10 front flips in one trick and land on your hooves.

guide.context: The chamber's low gravity gives you enough airtime for all 10 flips in one jump.

steps.text: Enter the building, climb the left-hand staircase into the office, and leap through its window into the low-gravity chamber.
While floating, perform 10 front flips and land gently on your hooves.

achievements.description: Drag a person into the treadmill with your tongue
achievements.summary: Drag a person onto the treadmill in the GoatVille spawn-house garage.

steps.text: Enter the garage of the fenced house behind the GoatVille spawn area and lick a person.
Pull the person with your tongue onto the treadmill.

achievements.description: Travel to space!
achievements.summary: Travel to space by placing the beacon on the empty pole in the GoatVille crop circle and boarding the UFO.

steps.text: Take the beacon from the table in the spawn-house garage that also holds the treadmill.
Carry it to the crop-circle field and place it on the empty pole beside the pole that already holds a beacon.
Wait for the UFO, then jump into the blue beam under its open hatch.
Use Respawn in the menu to leave space, which has no other exit.

achievements.description: Find all Goat Trophies on the GoatVille level
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 goat trophies hidden around GoatVille.

guide.context: Trophies also unlock a mutator at 5, 10, 20, and 30 collected.

achievements.description: Bounce 100 times on mattresses within 30 seconds
achievements.summary: Bounce 100 times on the construction-site mattresses within 30 seconds.

steps.text: Climb to the 5th floor of the tall unfinished construction building.
Jump on the mattress pile until you bounce uncontrollably, then keep bouncing 100 times within 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Lick the Hanging Glider
achievements.summary: Lick the hang glider from the top of the GoatVille crane.

steps.text: Climb the crane and wait for the hang glider to pass.
Jump toward the glider as it nears and grab it with your tongue.

achievements.description: Smell and look like one
achievements.summary: Buy the third hat at the Goat City Bay store while the Repulsive Goat power is active.

guide.context: The Repulsive Goat mutator, unlocked in the sewer, must be equipped for the store purchase to register.

steps.text: Go into the sewer by the bridge to gain the Repulsive Goat mutator.
Pick up a dollar bill, such as the one on the first floor of the elevator building.
Carry the bill to the store cash register as if paying, then choose the third hat.

achievements.description: Lick the rollercoaster with 6 batteries attached
achievements.summary: Lick the Goat City Bay roller coaster after attaching all six batteries.

steps.text: Attach the 6 batteries: on the coaster platform's right edge, on a nearby building roof, behind the cafe cash register, inside the alley's red container, on the roof behind the barrels, and behind the skyscraper roof stage.
Take the elevator to the top, get into the cart, and lick the coaster while holding on.

achievements.description: Ride the boat while on a sugar rush
achievements.summary: Reach the Goat City Bay boat while the Sugar House rush is active.

guide.context: Clipping the boat as you jump over it counts, so you do not need to fully board it.

steps.text: From the Goat City Bay spawn, walk forward and turn right into the house with the pool.
Lick the sugar on the table inside to start the rush.
Leave the house, turn left, and sprint to the boat while the rush lasts, licking it to ride along.

achievements.description: Go on the catapult with a rider on your back
achievements.summary: Launch from the dam catapult with an NPC riding on your back.

steps.text: Enter the amusement park rodeo arena and wait for a random NPC to mount your back.
Carry the rider to the catapult near the dam, get in, and launch.

achievements.description: srsly
achievements.summary: Bring the towel marked 42 from the Goat City Bay hotel roof to the crashed UFO behind the dam.

steps.text: Ride the elevator to the hotel roof party.
Drop down on the stage's left side to the lower roof, then take the towel marked 42 by the pool.
Jump down, head to the top of the dam, and walk up to the crashed UFO among the trees while holding the towel.

achievements.description: How do you catch goats?
achievements.summary: Unlock all six goat mutators from the GoatVille and Goat City Bay trophy sets.

guide.context: The six mutators are Tall, Feather, Giant, Space, Classy, and Shopping Goat, earned from 50 trophies total across the two maps.

steps.text: Collect enough GoatVille and Goat City Bay trophies to unlock all six mutators; the achievement also triggers automatically while completing both trophy sets.

achievements.description: Reach level 101
achievements.summary: Reach level 101 in the Goat MMO Simulator.

guide.context: The flips must end with a clean landing; crashing to the ground does not award the experience. The method can take more than one attempt.

steps.text: Unlock Anti-Gravity Goat by taking the PAYDAY flamingo into the sphere at the castle.
Equip Angel Goat and Anti-Gravity Goat, press R, and jump to rise high, then press R again to restore gravity.
Hold W and D, or other movement keys, to flip in the air and land on your hooves.

achievements.description: Visit all zones on the MMO level
achievements.summary: Visit every zone on the Goat MMO level.

guide.context: Your own house in Goatshire is the easiest zone to miss; following the roads or wandering visits all the rest.

steps.text: Travel through every zone on the MMO map, including entering your house in Goatshire.

achievements.description: Jump on the launchpad
achievements.summary: Enter the MMO hole behind Alice's tree and jump on the launchpad.

steps.text: Find Alice lying under a tree at the marked map spot and enter the hole behind the tree.
Choose Travel at the prompt, then jump on the launchpad in the large room.

achievements.description: Trash the server room
achievements.summary: Destroy everything in the hidden MMO server room in Alvesta.

steps.text: In Alvesta, enter the server room where the mountainside opens up.
Destroy the equipment until a fake error message appears and returns you to the main menu.

achievements.description: Throw Bilbo the dwarf into lava
achievements.summary: Hurl Bilbo the dwarf into the Goat MMO castle's lava.

steps.text: On the beach, enter the cave, turn right to find Bilbo, and grab him.
Leave the cave and make for the castle; once inside its grounds, hurl Bilbo into the lava.

achievements.summary: Collect all 20 goat trophies hidden around Goat MMO Simulator.

achievements.description: Survive 10 days
achievements.summary: Survive 10 in-game days on the GoatZ map.

guide.context: Mutators do not disable achievements. No Hunger Goat removes hunger only, while Casual Goat also makes you immortal.

steps.text: Load GoatZ and survive until the 10-day counter completes.
Optional: equip the Casual Goat mutator to become immortal and remove hunger.

achievements.description: Paraglide in the air for 1 minute
achievements.summary: Stay airborne on the paraglider for one minute on the GoatZ map.

steps.text: Pick up the paraglider on the roof of the Whiplash building.
Climb a high spot such as one of the two tall towers and jump off.
Press R to open the glider and stay airborne for 1 minute.

achievements.description: Beat the whiplash course without getting wet
achievements.summary: Complete the Whiplash water park obstacle course without touching the water.

guide.context: The course can be retried as many times as needed. The Angel Goat mutator raises your jump and glides landings, and F activates slow-motion for the propeller.

steps.text: Start at the beginning of the Whiplash obstacle course.
At the orange wall, jump on top of it and walk forward to skip the section.
Land on the green platform while avoiding the spinning propeller.
Reach the finish line by running across the final platforms without jumping.

achievements.description: Use the slippery slide to land in the kiddie pool
achievements.summary: Slide down the Whiplash water slide and land in the kiddie pool.

steps.text: Climb to the top of the Whiplash water slide.
Press Q to ragdoll, slide down holding W, and fly off the end into the small kiddie pool.

achievements.description: Find all Goat Trophies on the GoatZ level
achievements.summary: Collect all 32 goat trophies hidden around the GoatZ level.

guide.context: Rare reports exist of a trophy failing to register; if the count stalls, clearing the save is the last resort.

achievements.description: Are you bread?

Lick the second living bread from the yellow slide by the nearby pool.
Place both slices inside the toaster and jump on top of it to blast off.

achievements.description: A trip to the Moon
achievements.summary: Fly the PAYDAY flamingo straight up to the moon.

guide.context: There is no return trip from the moon; restart the game to leave.

steps.text: Equip the flamingo, fly straight upward until the game offers to travel to the next area, and accept.

achievements.description: Enable the hydraulic cars
achievements.summary: Take the gym radio to the dancing group by the PAYDAY Chinese restaurant.

steps.text: Grab the radio inside the Aerobics Center gym.
Approach the dancers by the Chinese restaurant; the radio drops to the ground on its own.

achievements.description: Headbutt someone out of their car, then run them over with it
achievements.summary: Headbutt a driver from their car, get in, and drive over them.

steps.text: Find a car with a driver, headbutt them out, take the wheel, and drive over them.

achievements.description: Show off your vehicle air control skills in the desert
achievements.summary: Drive the PAYDAY desert buggy through every green ring on the race track.

guide.context: Flying mutators also work if the goat itself passes through the rings. A failed run means hauling the buggy back to the beginning.

steps.text: Get in the buggy parked by the desert race track and drive through the first green ring.
Follow the rings that appear, boosting with Shift and jumping with LMB at the very edge of each ramp.

achievements.description: Place a hogtied NPC on the train tracks and wait for the train to arrive

guide.context: The Hogtie Goat mutator unlocks after collecting 10 PAYDAY trophies.

achievements.description: Complete the Test Chambers
achievements.summary: Complete all 8 test chambers in the Waste of Space building.

guide.context: The chambers unlock for $50,000. In chamber 8, breaking a laser keeps the door closed, so avoid the beams there.

steps.text: Chamber 1: carry the companion cow to the white button so it is sucked into the tube above.
Chamber 2: press the buttons until the door opens.
Chamber 3: place the cow on the upper platform and press the button; the falling fridge smashes the wall, then set the cow on the button beyond it.
Chamber 4: use the R tether device to bind the cow onto the tether arm, then press the button.
Chamber 5: tether the cow and press the four buttons in order from low to high to lift it to the top.
Chamber 6: tether the cow and press the button, blocking the laser-shooting chihuahuas with the buttons or headbutting them carefully.
Chamber 7: run forward through the maze until cow portraits cover the walls, then walk backward to the hole in the floor.
Chamber 8: press the button without breaking any laser, drop the cow, jump over the front laser, open the door, then carry the cow into the final room.

achievements.displayName: Splishy Splashy Wibbly Wobbly Timey Wimey
achievements.description: Visit the Badehaus
achievements.summary: Hit the blue TURDIS toilet stall at the Museum, Academy, Carrier, and Research, then enter the Badehaus pool room.

guide.context: Each hit sends the TURDIS to its next location, so visit the four areas in the listed order.

steps.text: Museum: head inside and go up to the second floor, walk to the far end, and hit the stall.
Academy: hit the stall at the middle of the area by the QR code monument.
Carrier: head the opposite way and go up the stairs to hit the stall.
Research: cross the bridge to the motorbike parking lot, hit the stall, and step through the unlocked door into the pool room.

achievements.description: Wrap a garl'eek in tinfoil
achievements.summary: Throw Garl'eek into the tinfoil machine at T-XAS.

guide.context: The Travel Agency unlocks for $25,000 in collected money. Garl'eek breaks free often, so keep re-licking him.

steps.text: Unlock the Travel Agency teleport and travel to T-XAS.
Find the weird goat Garl'eek and push him into the tinfoil machine.
